items.title: GUJCOST Robofest 5.0 — 14 Teams Qualified for Level-2, Highest in India
items.detail: 14 teams from TRS BVM advanced to Level-2 of Robofest 5.0 -- the highest number of teams selected from a single institution across the nation. Out of 1,102 ideation proposals submitted in Level-1 (914 at Senior Level), only 138 senior-level proposals were shortlisted for Level-2, and 14 of those were from BVM. Each advancing team received Rs 50,000. Categories: Underwater (Dr. A. A. Vahora, Dr. A. M. Thakkar, Prof. G. B. Rathod, Prof. V. J. Patel, Dr. M. S. Holia), Aerial (Prof. V. R. Singh), Maze (Dr. M. S. Holia), IGV (Prof. V. J. Patel, Prof. H. P. Patolia), Application (Prof. D. M. Patel, Prof. H. P. Patolia, Prof. D. K. Patel, Dr. M. M. Solanki, Prof. J. R. Koisa).

items.title: GUJCOST Robofest 5.0 — 13 Teams Qualified for the Grand Finale
items.detail: Out of a total of 82 teams selected nationwide for the Grand Finale (Level-3), 13 teams from TRS BVM qualified — out of the 14 teams that had advanced to Level-2.

items.title: GUJCOST Robofest 3.0 — All 14 Teams Qualified for Level-3
items.detail: All 14 TRS BVM teams advanced to Level-3 of Robofest 3.0 -- out of 630 teams that applied for Level-1, only 151 reached Level-2, and 67 teams (including all 14 from BVM) were shortlisted for Level-3. Cash prizes for this stage ranged from Rs 1,00,000 to Rs 2,00,000 per team, Rs 22,00,000 total across all 67 teams. Categories: Maze Solving (Prof. A. M. Thakkar, Prof. M. S. Holia), Hexapod (Prof. H. P. Patolia, Prof. M. M. Solanki), Submarine (Prof. G. B. Rathod, Prof. J. R. Koisa), Rover (Prof. V. R. Singh, Prof. D. M. Patel), Self-Balancing (Prof. V. J. Patel, Prof. A. N. Roghalia), Swarm Robot (Prof. A. M. Thakkar, Prof. R. B. Gandhi, Prof. V. J. Patel), Home Cleaning Robot (Prof. M. S. Holia).

items.title: GUJCOST Robofest 3.0 — 14 Teams Qualified for Level-2
items.detail: All 14 TRS BVM teams were selected for Level-2 of Robofest 3.0, a global-level robot-making competition by GUJCOST, Gandhinagar -- out of 630 proposals submitted nationally and internationally for Level-1, only 151 advanced. Each team received Rs 50,000 (Rs 7,00,000 total). Categories: Maze Solving (Prof. M. S. Holia, Prof. A. M. Thakkar), Hexapod (Dr. H. P. Patolia, Dr. M. M. Solanki), Rover (Prof. V. R. Singh, Dr. D. M. Patel), Home Cleaning Robot (Prof. M. S. Holia), Self-Balancing (Prof. V. J. Patel, Prof. A. K. Roghelia), Submarine (Prof. G. B. Rathod, Prof. J. R. Koisa), Swarm Robot (Prof. A. M. Thakkar, Dr. R. B. Gandhi, Prof. V. J. Patel).

items.title: GUJCOST Robofest 2.0 — All 5 Teams Win First Position
items.detail: All five TRS BVM teams -- Quadruped, Underwater Robot, Prosthetic Limbs, Micro-Robots, and Pipe Climbing Robot -- won first position in their respective categories. Rs 5,00,000 cash prize per team (Rs 25,00,000 total). Felicitated by Shri Jitubhai Vaghani, Education Minister of Gujarat, on 29 October 2022 at Swarnim Sankul-1, Gandhinagar. Overall Mentor: Prof. Vinay Patel.

join.heading: Joining TRS is on paper, on purpose.
join.description: Membership isn't an online form — it's an official enrollment form you download, fill in, and submit in person. That's how we keep it a real commitment.
steps: Fill it in and get it signed where required.
Submit it physically to the faculty enrollment contact.
